title: Duecare Gemma Content Classification Evaluation Wheels
subtitle: Wheels for the side-by-side OFF/ON content-classification evaluation across 51 bundled cases
description: v3.16 - wheels for gemma-content-classification-evaluation. Bundled: duecare-llm-chat / -core / -models. Runs all 51 classifier examples (16 originals + 30 persona x corridor + 5 multimodal SVG) through the classifier twice (harness OFF vs harness ON) and emits per-case OFF/ON delta + aggregate lift number + per-case markdown table.
